description: Switches a data agent to the preview runtime (Advanced NL2SQL) for its SQL sources. The standard runtime uses GA NL2SQL; the preview runtime adds multi-step reasoning (better example-query following, filter-value substitution, ambiguity handling). Runtime selection uses the SAME per-source config (schema selection, data source instructions, example queries) — no reconfiguration needed. Use --disable-preview-runtime to switch back to the standard runtime.

data.instructions: Answer questions about sales. Use SQL for lakehouse and warehouse tables.

notes: The previewRuntime boolean reports the effective runtime after the change (true = preview/Advanced NL2SQL, false = standard/NL2SQL). It maps to the nested settings field experimental.enableExperimentalFeatures. Only staging is modified; publish the agent to promote it — the runtime a published agent uses is fixed at publish time (republish to change it). --enable-preview-runtime and --disable-preview-runtime are mutually exclusive and can be combined with --instructions/--instructions-file. Verify with: fabio data-agent get-config -w $WS_ID --id $AGENT_ID (its previewRuntime field mirrors this).

query_examples.description: Whether the preview runtime (Advanced NL2SQL) is now enabled.
